description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's status and merge features. It sets up various repository states and verifies the output of Git commands related to conflict resolution and status reporting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the enclosed commands to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the mock timer used in tests.
